messages:
Maria G.: Hey team — starting v0.9.3 release notes draft. Triage request: can someone sanity-check the 'Known issues' block and the short feature callouts? Link sweep after edits appreciated. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428

Devon: looks good. Two things: embedding docs have a param rename — need mention. Also customer's report about streaming truncation on slow clients.

Sam: I'll add the embedding param note. Proposed blurb:

> Embeddings API: param name change — 'vector_precision' -> 'precision'. If you upgrade client SDKs, confirm calls use 'precision' to avoid 400s.

Olivia - PM: Add a migration note for dedicated users who pinned model v2.2 — fallback behavior changed during partial rollouts.

Maria G.: Draft known-issues block (paste):

```
Known issues
- Streaming clients on flaky networks may see partial responses if the connection resets during long responses. Workaround: enable chunked-retry in the client or set streaming_timeout_ms to 12000.
- Embeddings SDK: parameter 'vector_precision' has been renamed to 'precision'; older SDKs will return 400. Update instructions here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk#upgrade-guide
- Dedicated deployments: during canary rollouts of 2.2 -> 2.3 some requests may be routed to legacy variants. If you rely on KV-cache semantics, pin to model v2.2 until rollout completes.
```

DocsBot: link-checker found 3 HTTP redirects and 1 broken anchor: /sdk#upgrade-guide -> /sdk/upgrade#parameters; anchor mismatch in /guides/model-compatibility#kv-cache

Devon: Adding small wording tweak: change "Workaround: enable chunked-retry..." to "Workaround: enable chunked-retry or increase streaming_timeout_ms to 12000." Also can we include snippet for JS SDK call?

Sam: snippet (JS):

```js
// Upgrade example
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'embed-small-002',
  input: 'text',
  precision: 'float16'
});
```

Olivia - PM: Can we add a short "What to expect" bullet for customers using private deployments? One line about audit logs unaffected.

Maria G.: I'll update PR with these edits and ping eng-ml for a quick signoff. @devon @sam please review the PR diff in the next 2 hours. :clock2:

Devon: on it, will check now. :eyes:

Sam: reviewed, small grammar fix pushed. :thumbsup:

DocsBot: Link sweep re-run: all redirects resolved except /guides/model-compatibility#kv-cache — created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1123

Maria G.: Thanks — merging after CI passes. I'll post the relnotes in #product and schedule the site publish for 2026-03-22 10:00 PST.

Olivia - PM: Thanks everyone. :partyparrot:
